brief: How I saved $50K on a $70K salary — 6 boring habits.

slots.title: AUTO-SAVE
slots.body: I split my paycheck so thirty percent never hit my checking account. Out of sight meant out of mind, and the pile grew silently every two weeks.

slots.title: MEAL PREP
slots.body: I stopped ordering lunch and started batch-cooking every Sunday. It saved me roughly three hundred dollars a month and removed daily decision fatigue entirely.

slots.title: 48-HOUR RULE
slots.body: Before any non-essential purchase, I waited two full days. Most urges vanished by morning, and my impulse spending practically disappeared overnight.

slots.title: AUDIT BILLS
slots.body: I called providers once a year to negotiate phone, insurance, and streaming rates. Fifteen minutes of awkward calls usually cut my fixed costs by ten percent.

slots.title: BUY USED
slots.body: Cars, furniture, and electronics were bought secondhand after quick research. Depreciation is a wealth killer, so I let someone else take the first hit.

slots.title: WEEKLY CHECK-IN
slots.body: I spent ten minutes every Sunday reviewing transactions instead of budgeting monthly. Small leaks were spotted fast before they could sink the ship.

slots.headline: START SAVING
slots.body: Pick one habit this week and automate it. Small, boring moves compound into life-changing piles of cash faster than you think.
